== SLA VISUALIZATION DEVIATION ==
Spec §3 says 'SLA trends (p50/p90 series per bucket)' but GET /analytics/operations returns ONE scalar
SlaPercentileDto per metric (not a bucketed series). A time-series line chart cannot be drawn from 4 scalar
pairs. Resolution: grouped bar chart (4 x-axis metrics, 2 series p50/p90, values in minutes). This is the
faithful representation of the actual DTO — the spec described a richer endpoint that the backend didn't
implement (bucket-series would require joining with a time dimension). The chart is more useful as a bar
because it allows direct p50/p90 comparison across the 4 metrics. This deviation is noted and intentional.
